python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

img1 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0001.png')

# 2. Sofa (gray, far left):
# Let's inspect sofa pixels: cols 100 to 205, rows 260 to 325
sofa_mask = (img1[:, 100:205, 0] > 70) & (img1[:, 100:205, 0] < 120) & \
            (abs(img1[:, 100:205, 0].astype(int) - img1[:, 100:205, 1].astype(int)) < 10) & \
            (abs(img1[:, 100:205, 1].astype(int) - img1[:, 100:205, 2].astype(int)) < 10)

sofa_r, sofa_c = np.where(sofa_mask)
print('Sofa row range:', sofa_r.min(), sofa_r.max())
print('Sofa col range:', sofa_c.min() + 100, sofa_c.max() + 100)

# Bottom edge of sofa:
for r in range(310, 325):
    print(r, img1[r, 150])
"
